label: Hook-owned automatic liquidity
summary: Convert hook-controlled proceeds into canonical-pool liquidity from custom hook callbacks under bounded execution and custody rules.
requiredFacts: Hook-owned funding source, liability separation, threshold, cadence, slippage and deadline
Which authenticated hook path schedules or triggers execution and what happens when execution fails
Position ownership, fee ownership, custody, removal and emergency exit
requiredTests: Slippage, deadline, zero-liquidity and adverse-price failures
Position creation, fee collection, removal and owner exits
Reentrancy, nested PoolManager actions and insolvency invariants
risks: Hook-controlled swaps can be sandwiched or recursively triggered
Unclear LP custody can strand or redirect value
